n1.text: Build board: the chart, pills and receipt card are the handoff's, unchanged. New: the figures strip under the chart and the link to the project's plan.

n2.text:
How the figures work (PMP earned-value style, in points, not money):
· Planned = points the plan has due by today
· Verified = points with an anchored receipt
· Variance = verified − planned
· SPI = verified ÷ planned (under 1 is behind)
· Forecast = finish at the current pace
All figures here are samples.
